title: Which ways of adding up to zero did a list miss? Introductory text to Missing types in the conjectural classification of minimal vanishing sums of roots of unity of weights 17 to 21
description: A plain-language introduction to a research paper on minimal vanishing sums of roots of unity of weights 17 to 21 that a conjectural classification missed. The paper has the proofs; this note has the idea, and it says what the paper does and does not claim.
